extractions.quote_text: suggesting that the D3-enriched population was spiny and the HTR7-enriched population was aspiny, confirming a prior morphological analysis of ITC neurons
extractions.action: new quote written to refs; added as morphology.sources entry — provides cross-species (human/NHP) transcriptomic evidence for morphological heterogeneity (spiny vs aspiny ITC subtypes)

notes: New morphology source from Totty et al. 2024 (PMID:39463931) snRNA-seq in human/NHP amygdala — TSHZ1+/FOXP2+ ITC subtypes differ in morphology (D3+/DRD1+ = spiny; HTR7+ = aspiny). This strengthens the intercalated_cell_mass_neuron morphology claim beyond the existing Veinante et al. 2013 reference.
